description: Get analytics for a single video over a date range (views, watch time, average view duration/percentage, subscribers gained, likes, comments, shares). Requires the yt-analytics.readonly scope.

account.description: Account name to query. Use list_accounts to see available options. Defaults to the first configured account.

metrics.description: Comma-separated metric list. Defaults to a standard organic set.

name: get_video_analytics
